items.quote: 3:44 And the LORD spake unto Moses, saying, 3:45 Take the Levites instead of all the firstborn among the children of Israel, and the cattle of the Levites instead of their cattle; and the Levites shall be mine: I am the LORD.
items.claim: The text says the LORD told Moses to take the Levites in place of all the firstborn of the children of Israel, and the Levites' cattle in place of the Israelites' cattle, and declared that the Levites belong to the LORD.
items.action: commands that the Levites be taken in place of Israel's firstborn, and the Levites' cattle in place of the Israelites' cattle
items.object: the Levites and their cattle; the firstborn of the children of Israel and their cattle
items.mechanism: substitution: the Levites and their cattle take the place of Israel's firstborn and cattle, and the Levites are claimed as the LORD's own
